title: Revolver 'British Bull-dog' Tapestry
finished_size_cm: 24 x 16 (chart area about 22 x 14, plus a 2-round border)
yarn_note: Made with light (DK, CYC 3) yarn and a 4.0 mm hook at a gauge of about 18 sc and 20 rows = 10 cm, so the 40 x 27 stitch chart measures about 22 x 14 cm and the border adds about 1 cm on each side. A thinner yarn makes the piece smaller and a thicker yarn makes it larger, so check your gauge first.

other: tapestry needle for weaving in ends
pins and a damp cloth for blocking

parts.name: Chart panel (40 stitches x 27 rows)
parts.color: A, B, C, D, E as given by the chart

steps.instruction: With A, ch 41. This is 40 stitches plus 1 ch for the first stitch.
Sc in the 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, changing colours as shown in chart row 1. Work the stitches over the unused yarn as described in the notes.
Ch 1 (does not count as a stitch), turn, and sc in each stitch across, following the colour runs of the matching chart row. Odd rows are RS rows and even rows are WS rows.

Row 1 is the bottom row of the picture. If the runs are printed left to right as seen on the chart, work them in that order on even (WS) rows. On odd (RS) rows work them in reverse, starting at the right end of the chart. Every row has 40 stitches.

Work the last sc of the old colour until 2 loops remain on the hook. Finish it by pulling through the new colour. Carry the unused colours along the top of the previous row and crochet over them so they are hidden inside the stitches. Use a small separate length of yarn or a bobbin for isolated spots, such as the 4 stitches of E. Do not carry a colour across more than about 6 stitches. Past that, use a separate length of yarn.
After row 27, do not fasten off. Continue with the border.

With RS facing, join B in the top right corner. Work 40 sc across the top, 3 sc in the corner, 27 sc evenly down the left side (1 per row end), 3 sc in the corner, 40 sc across the foundation edge, 3 sc in the corner, 27 sc up the right side, 3 sc in the last corner. Join with sl st to the first sc. The total is 40 + 27 + 40 + 27 + 4 x 3 = 146 stitches.
Ch 1, sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in the middle sc of each 3-sc corner. Join with sl st to the first sc and fasten off. Corners add 4 x 2 stitches, so the total is 146 + 8 = 154.

assembly: Weave in all ends on the wrong side with the tapestry needle, running them through stitches of the same colour.
Pin the piece flat, lightly steam or dampen it, and let it dry to even out the stitches and corners.
notes: Keep the tension of the carried yarn loose so the piece does not pucker. Always bring the new colour up from the same side, for example from the back, so the colour changes look neat. Tick off each row as you finish it. Colour A is the background and uses the most yarn, so start with a full ball.
